## Improve annotation processor logging output and deduplication

As a Kora Framework maintainer, we need to improve the logging experience for our annotation processors. The current logging implementation has several issues that make debug output noisy and less useful for developers:

    1. **No console output**: Currently, all logging from the annotation processors (both the Java annotation processor and the Kotlin Symbol Processing (KSP) variant) only goes to a file in the build directory. Developers debugging their application can't easily see processor logs in their build console output.

    2. **Verbose per-round logging**: The processors log every component/module found on every annotation processing round, even when the same elements are processed again in subsequent rounds (which happens regularly in incremental builds and with multi-round processing). This creates a lot of duplicate log noise.

    3. **Scattered log entries**: Components and modules are currently logged one-by-one as they're discovered, making it hard to get an overview of what the processor found at a glance.

    4. **Inconsistent log levels**: The default log level is DEBUG, which may be too verbose for most builds.

    The goal is to:
    - Add console (stdout) output for processor logs in addition to the file appender.
    - Deduplicate log messages for components, application modules, and external modules so each is only logged once across all processing rounds.
    - Group log messages to provide a concise summary of discovered components and modules.
    - Change the default log level from DEBUG to INFO for a less noisy default experience.
    - Update log message text/format to be more consistent and useful.

    Please ensure both the Java annotation processor (`KoraAppProcessor.java`) and the KSP processor (`KoraAppProcessor.kt`) are updated to maintain feature parity.

## Environment Setup
Check the repository's root `build.gradle` and `gradle/ci-tests.gradle` for the overall build configuration and how tests are wired. Look at `gradle.properties` for project-level Gradle settings. The modules `annotation-processor-common`, `kora-app-annotation-processor`, and `kora-app-symbol-processor` each have their own `build.gradle` files that define their specific dependencies and test task configurations. Review `settings.gradle` to understand module layout and included builds. The `gradlew` script is the standard Gradle wrapper for running any Gradle commands.

## Implementation Plan
1. **Update `BuildEnvironment.java`** in `annotation-processor-common/src/main/java/ru/tinkoff/kora/annotation/processor/common/`:
       - Add a `ConsoleAppender` alongside the existing `FileAppender`. Configure both appenders with the same `PatternLayoutEncoder` instance.
       - Update the log pattern to a more concise format: `%d{HH:mm:ss.SSS} %-5level [%thread] %logger{36} - %msg%n`.
       - Set UTF-8 charset on the encoder.
       - Change the default log level from `DEBUG` to `INFO` when `koraLogLevel` option is not provided.
       - Update the timestamp format in the log file name from `yyyy-MM-dd-hh-mm` to `yyyy-MM-dd'T'hh-mm-ss`.

    2. **Update Java `KoraAppProcessor.java`** in `kora-app-annotation-processor/src/main/java/ru/tinkoff/kora/kora/app/annotation/processor/`:
       - Add static `Set<TypeElement>` fields to track already-logged components, application modules, and external modules (e.g., `loggedComponents`, `loggedApplicationModules`, `loggedExternalModules`).
       - In `init()`, change the startup log message to be more descriptive (e.g., "Starting @KoraApp processor").
       - In `processComponents()`, collect components into a local list first. Log the "waiting for AOP proxy" components as a group, and log the regular components as a group only if they haven't been logged before (tracked by `loggedComponents`).
       - In `processModules()`, collect modules into a local list first. Log the application modules as a grouped, multi-line message (sorted, indented) only if they haven't been logged before (tracked by `loggedApplicationModules`). Track external modules separately and log them similarly.
       - Replace `putIfAbsent` with `computeIfAbsent` for the `@KoraApp` elements map as a minor cleanup.

    3. **Update KSP `KoraAppProcessor.kt`** in `kora-app-symbol-processor/src/main/kotlin/ru/tinkoff/kora/kora/app/ksp/`:
       - Change the log message for found `@KoraApp` from "Kora app found: {}" to "@KoraApp found: {}".
       - In `processComponents()`, collect components into local lists for AOP-waiting and regular components. Log them as grouped messages instead of one-by-one.
       - In `processModules()`, apply similar grouping/deduplication logic as the Java processor for consistency (use a set to track already-logged modules).

483:         statement.add(", $T.of(", List.class);
484:         var interceptorsFor = interceptors.interceptorsFor(component);
485:         for (int i = 0; i < interceptorsFor.size(); i++) {
486:             var interceptor = interceptorsFor.get(i);
487:             if (component.holderName().equals(interceptor.component().holderName())) {
488:                 statement.add("$N", interceptor.component().fieldName());
489:             } else {
490:                 statement.add("$N.$N", interceptor.component().holderName(), interceptor.component().fieldName());
491:             }
492:             if (i < interceptorsFor.size() - 1) {
493:                 statement.add(", ");
494:             }
495:         }
496:         statement.add(")");
497:         for (var resolvedDependency : resolvedDependencies) {
498:             if (resolvedDependency instanceof ComponentDependency.AllOfDependency allOf) {

500:                     var dependencies = GraphResolutionHelper.findDependenciesForAllOf(ctx, allOf.claim(), components);
501:                     for (var dependency : dependencies) {

503:                             statement.add(", $N", dependency.component().fieldName());
504:                         } else {
505:                             statement.add(", $N.$N", dependency.component().holderName(), dependency.component().fieldName());
506:                         }

513:             }

515:                 continue;
516:             }

518:             if (resolvedDependency instanceof ComponentDependency.SingleDependency dependency && dependency.component() != null) {
519:                 if (component.holderName().equals(dependency.component().holderName())) {

521:                 } else {

523:                 }

440:         resolver: Resolver,
441:         declaration: KSClassDeclaration,
442:         allModules: List<KSClassDeclaration>,
443:         graph: List<ResolvedComponent>,
444:         interceptors: ComponentInterceptors
445:     ): FileSpec {

447:         val containingFile = declaration.containingFile!!
448:         val packageName = containingFile.packageName.asString()

451: 
452:         val fileSpec = FileSpec.builder(
453:             packageName = packageName,
454:             fileName = graphName
455:         )
456: 
457:         val implClass = ClassName(packageName, "${declaration.simpleName.asString()}Impl")
458:         val supplierSuperInterface = supplier.toClassName().parameterizedBy(CommonClassNames.applicationGraphDraw)
459:         val classBuilder = TypeSpec.classBuilder(graphName)
460:             .addOriginatingKSFile(containingFile)
461:             .generated(KoraAppProcessor::class)
462:             .addSuperinterface(supplierSuperInterface)
463:             .addFunction(
464:                 FunSpec.builder("get")
465:                     .addModifiers(KModifier.OVERRIDE)
466:                     .returns(CommonClassNames.applicationGraphDraw)
467:                     .addStatement("return graphDraw")
468:                     .build()
469:             )
470: 
471:         for (component in this.components) {
472:             classBuilder.addOriginatingKSFile(component.containingFile!!)
473:         }
474:         for (module in annotatedModules) {
475:             classBuilder.addOriginatingKSFile(module.containingFile!!)
476:         }
477:         val companion = TypeSpec.companionObjectBuilder()
478:             .addProperty("graphDraw", CommonClassNames.applicationGraphDraw)
479: 
480:         var currentClass: TypeSpec.Builder? = null
481:         var currentConstructor: FunSpec.Builder? = null
482:         var holders = 0
483: 
484:         for (i in graph.indices) {
485:             val componentNumber = i % COMPONENTS_PER_HOLDER_CLASS
486:             if (componentNumber == 0) {
487:                 if (currentClass != null) {
488:                     currentClass.primaryConstructor(currentConstructor!!.build())
489:                     classBuilder.addType(currentClass.build())
490:                     val prevNumber = i / COMPONENTS_PER_HOLDER_CLASS - 1
491:                     companion.addProperty("holder$prevNumber", graphTypeName.nestedClass("ComponentHolder$prevNumber"))
492:                 }
493:                 holders++
494:                 val className = graphTypeName.nestedClass("ComponentHolder" + i / COMPONENTS_PER_HOLDER_CLASS)
495:                 currentClass = TypeSpec.classBuilder(className)
496:                 currentConstructor = FunSpec.constructorBuilder()
497:                     .addParameter("graphDraw", CommonClassNames.applicationGraphDraw)
498:                     .addParameter("impl", implClass)
499:                     .addStatement("val self = %T", graphTypeName)
500:                     .addStatement("val map = %T<%T, %T>()", HashMap::class.asClassName(), String::class.asClassName(), Type::class.asClassName())
501:                     .controlFlow("for (field in %T::class.java.declaredFields)", className) {
502:                         controlFlow("if (!field.name.startsWith(%S))", "component") { addStatement("continue") }
503:                         addStatement("map[field.name] = (field.genericType as %T).actualTypeArguments[0]", ParameterizedType::class.asClassName())
504:                     }
505:                 for (j in 0 until i / COMPONENTS_PER_HOLDER_CLASS) {
506:                     currentConstructor.addParameter("ComponentHolder$j", graphTypeName.nestedClass("ComponentHolder$j"));
507:                 }
508:             }
509:             val component = graph[i];
510:             currentClass!!.addProperty(component.fieldName, CommonClassNames.node.parameterizedBy(component.type.toTypeName()))
511:             val statement = this.generateComponentStatement(allModules, interceptors, graph, component)
512:             currentConstructor!!.addCode(statement).addCode("\n")
513:         }
514:         if (graph.isNotEmpty()) {
515:             var lastComponentNumber = graph.size / COMPONENTS_PER_HOLDER_CLASS;
516:             if (graph.size % COMPONENTS_PER_HOLDER_CLASS == 0) {
517:                 lastComponentNumber--;
518:             }
519:             currentClass!!.addFunction(currentConstructor!!.build());
520:             classBuilder.addType(currentClass.build())
521:             companion.addProperty("holder$lastComponentNumber", graphTypeName.nestedClass("ComponentHolder$lastComponentNumber"));
522:         }
523:

525:         val initBlock = CodeBlock.builder()
526:             .addStatement("val self = %T", graphTypeName)
527:             .addStatement("val impl = %T()", implClass)
528:             .addStatement("graphDraw =  %T(%T::class.java)", ApplicationGraphDraw::class, declaration.toClassName())
529:         for (i in 0 until holders) {
530:             initBlock.add("%N = %T(graphDraw, impl", "holder$i", graphTypeName.nestedClass("ComponentHolder$i"))
531:             for (j in 0 until i) {
532:                 initBlock.add(", holder$j")
533:             }
534:             initBlock.add(")\n");
535:         }
536: 
537:         val supplierMethodBuilder = FunSpec.builder("graph")
538:             .returns(ApplicationGraphDraw::class)
539:             .addCode("\nreturn graphDraw\n", declaration.simpleName.asString() + "Graph")
540:         return fileSpec.addType(
541:             classBuilder
542:                 .addType(companion.addInitializerBlock(initBlock.build()).addFunction(supplierMethodBuilder.build()).build())
543:                 .addFunction(supplierMethodBuilder.build())
544:                 .build()
545:         ).build()

548:     private fun generateComponentStatement(
549:         allModules: List<KSClassDeclaration>,
550:         interceptors: ComponentInterceptors,
551:         components: List<ResolvedComponent>,
552:         component: ResolvedComponent
553:     ): CodeBlock {
554:         val statement = CodeBlock.builder()
555:         val declaration = component.declaration
556:         statement.add("%N = graphDraw.addNode0(map[%S], ", component.fieldName, component.fieldName)
557:         statement.indent().add("\n")
558:         statement.add("arrayOf(")
559:         for (tag in component.tags) {
560:             statement.add("%L::class.java, ", tag)
561:         }
562:         statement.add("),\n")
563:         statement.add("{ ")
564:         val dependenciesCode = this.getDependenciesCode(component, components)
565: 
566:         when (declaration) {
567:             is ComponentDeclaration.AnnotatedComponent -> {
568:                 statement.add("%T", declaration.classDeclaration.toClassName())
569:                 if (declaration.typeVariables.isNotEmpty()) {
570:                     statement.add("<")
571:                     for ((i, tv) in declaration.typeVariables.withIndex()) {
572:                         if (i > 0) {
573:                             statement.add(", ")
574:                         }
575:                         statement.add("%L", tv.type!!.toTypeName())
576:                     }
577:                     statement.add(">")
578:                 }
579:                 statement.add("(%L)", dependenciesCode)
580:             }
581: 
582:             is ComponentDeclaration.FromModuleComponent -> {
583:                 if (declaration.module is ModuleDeclaration.AnnotatedModule) {
584:                     statement.add("impl.module%L.", allModules.indexOf(declaration.module.element))
585:                 } else {
586:                     statement.add("impl.")
587:                 }
588:                 statement.add("%N", declaration.method.simpleName.asString())
589:                 if (declaration.typeVariables.isNotEmpty()) {
590:                     statement.add("<")
591:                     for ((i, tv) in declaration.typeVariables.withIndex()) {
592:                         if (i > 0) {
593:                             statement.add(", ")
594:                         }
595:                         statement.add("%L", tv.type!!.toTypeName())
596:                     }
597:                     statement.add(">")
598:                 }
599:                 statement.add("(%L)", dependenciesCode)
600:             }
601: 
602:             is ComponentDeclaration.FromExtensionComponent -> {
603:                 statement.add(declaration.generator(dependenciesCode))
604:             }
605: 
606:             is ComponentDeclaration.DiscoveredAsDependencyComponent -> {
607:                 statement.add("%T(%L)", declaration.classDeclaration.toClassName(), dependenciesCode)
608:             }
609: 
610:             is ComponentDeclaration.PromisedProxyComponent -> {
611:                 statement.add("%T(%L)", declaration.className, dependenciesCode)
612:             }
613: 
614:             is ComponentDeclaration.OptionalComponent -> {
615:                 statement.add("%T.ofNullable(%L)", Optional::class.asClassName(), dependenciesCode)
616:             }
617:         }
618:         statement.add(" },\n")
619:         statement.add("listOf(")
620:         for ((i, interceptor) in interceptors.interceptorsFor(declaration).withIndex()) {
621:             if (i > 0) {
622:                 statement.add(", ")
623:             }
624:             if (component.holderName == interceptor.component.holderName) {
625:                 statement.add("%N", interceptor.component.fieldName)
626:             } else {
627:                 statement.add("%N.%N", interceptor.component.holderName, interceptor.component.fieldName)
628:             }
629:         }
630:         statement.add(")")
631: 
632:         var rn = false
633:         for (dependency in component.dependencies) {
634:             if (dependency is ComponentDependency.AllOfDependency) {
635:                 if (dependency.claim.claimType != DependencyClaim.DependencyClaimType.ALL_OF_PROMISE) {
636:                     val dependencies = GraphResolutionHelper.findDependenciesForAllOf(ctx!!, dependency.claim, components)
637:                     for (d in dependencies) {
638:                         if (!rn) {
639:                             rn = true
640:                             statement.add(",\n")
641:                         } else {
642:                             statement.add(", ")
643:                         }
644:                         if (component.holderName == d.component!!.holderName) {
645:                             statement.add("%N", d.component!!.fieldName)
646:                         } else {
647:                             statement.add("%N.%N", d.component!!.holderName, d.component!!.fieldName)
648:                         }
649:                         if (dependency.claim.claimType == DependencyClaim.DependencyClaimType.ALL_OF_VALUE) {
650:                             statement.add(".valueOf()")
651:                         }
652:                     }
653:                 }
654:                 continue
655:             }
656:             if (dependency is ComponentDependency.PromiseOfDependency) {
657:                 continue
658:             }
659:             if (dependency is ComponentDependency.PromisedProxyParameterDependency) {
660:                 continue
661:             }
662:             if (dependency is ComponentDependency.SingleDependency && dependency.component != null) {
663:                 if (!rn) {
664:                     rn = true
665:                     statement.add(",\n")
666:                 } else {
667:                     statement.add(", ")
668:                 }
669:                 if (component.holderName == dependency.component!!.holderName) {
670:                     statement.add("%N", dependency.component!!.fieldName)
671:                 } else {
672:                     statement.add("%N.%N", dependency.component!!.holderName, dependency.component!!.fieldName)
673:                 }
674:                 if (dependency is ComponentDependency.ValueOfDependency) {
675:                     statement.add(".valueOf()")
676:                 }
677:             }
678:         }
679:         statement.unindent()
680:         statement.add("\n)")
681:         return statement.add("\n").build()
682:     }

684:     private fun getDependenciesCode(component: ResolvedComponent, components: List<ResolvedComponent>): CodeBlock {
685:         if (component.dependencies.isEmpty()) {
686:             return CodeBlock.of("")
687:         }
688:         val block = CodeBlock.builder().indent().add("\n")
689:         for ((i, dependency) in component.dependencies.withIndex()) {
690:             if (i > 0) {
691:                 block.add(",\n")
692:             }
693:             block.add(dependency.write(ctx!!, components))
694:         }
695:         block.unindent().add("\n")
696:         return block.build()
697:     }

We need to address two related issues in the Undertow HTTP server implementation:

    1. **Headers are lost for streaming responses**: When a response body is sent through the streaming path (i.e., when the body is not available in full upfront and we fall back to `sendStreamingBody`), any response headers that were set on the `HttpServerResponse` are not propagated to the callback that closes the response lifecycle. This means that the `PublicApiResponse` completion hook (`closeSendResponseSuccess`) receives `null` headers instead of the actual headers, which can break telemetry, tracing, or other logic that relies on response headers being present.

    2. **Premature exchange completion detection**: In a specific case where the Undertow exchange is already marked as complete when the sender's `onComplete` callback fires, the current code assumes it must add an exchange complete listener and call `endExchange()`. However, if the exchange is already complete, calling `endExchange()` or adding a listener can lead to errors or double-completion. We need to handle this scenario gracefully.

    The goal is to make sure streaming responses correctly pass the response headers through the whole lifecycle and that the exchange completion path is robust whether or not the exchange is already complete.

    Please also check `HttpHeaders` — it may be helpful to provide an immutable singleton empty instance to represent "no headers" without allocating a new mutable object each time (used in the non-streaming fallback path).

The OpenAPI generator currently only recognizes `application/json` as a JSON content type when deciding whether to attach a JSON mapper tag to request/response bodies. However, OpenAPI specifications commonly declare JSON content with charset parameters, such as `application/json; charset=utf-8`, or use the alternative `text/json` media type. These variants are currently not recognized, causing the generator to skip the JSON mapper annotation and produce incorrect HTTP client/server code.

    The goal is to broaden the JSON content type detection so that any content type starting with `application/json` or `text/json` (including those with parameters like `charset=utf-8`) is treated as JSON for the purpose of mapper tag assignment. This should apply consistently to:
    - Request body parameters
    - Form parameters
    - Response bodies

    Please also ensure existing tests still pass and add or update test fixture YAML files to cover content types with charset parameters and `text/plain` non-JSON content.

80:     @Override
81:     public boolean process(Set<? extends TypeElement> annotations, RoundEnvironment roundEnv) {
82:         if (!this.initialized) {
83:             return false;
84:         }
85:         this.processGenerated(roundEnv);
86:         var newModules = this.processModules(roundEnv);
87:         var newComponents = this.processComponents(roundEnv);
88:         this.processAppParts(roundEnv);
89:         if (newModules || newComponents) {
90:             for (var app : new ArrayList<>(this.annotatedElements.keySet())) {
91:                 this.annotatedElements.put(app, parseNone(app));
92:             }
93:         }
94:         var koraAppElements = roundEnv.getElementsAnnotatedWith(this.koraAppElement);
95:         for (var element : koraAppElements) {
96:             if (element.getKind() == ElementKind.INTERFACE) {
97:                 log.info("@KoraApp found: {}", element);
98:                 this.annotatedElements.computeIfAbsent((TypeElement) element, e -> parseNone(e));
99:             } else {
100:                 this.processingEnv.getMessager().printMessage(Diagnostic.Kind.ERROR, "@KoraApp can be placed only on interfaces", element);
101:             }
102:         }
103: 
104:         var results = new HashMap<TypeElement, ProcessingState>();
105:         if (!roundEnv.processingOver()) for (var annotatedClass : this.annotatedElements.entrySet()) {
106:             var processingResult = annotatedClass.getValue();
107:             if (processingResult instanceof ProcessingState.Ok) {
108:                 continue;
109:             }
110:             try {
111:                 if (processingResult instanceof ProcessingState.Failed failed) {
112:                     processingResult = this.parseNone(annotatedClass.getKey());
113:                 }
114:                 if (processingResult instanceof ProcessingState.None none) {
115:                     processingResult = this.processNone(none);
116:                 }
117:                 if (processingResult instanceof ProcessingState.NewRoundRequired newRound) {
118:                     var newState = this.processProcessing(roundEnv, newRound.processing());
119:                     results.put(annotatedClass.getKey(), newState);
120:                     continue;
121:                 }
122:                 if (processingResult instanceof ProcessingState.Processing processing) {
123:                     var newState = this.processProcessing(roundEnv, processing);
124:                     results.put(annotatedClass.getKey(), newState);
125:                 }
126:             } catch (NewRoundException e) {
127:                 if (!roundEnv.processingOver() || processingResult instanceof ProcessingState.None) {
128:                     results.put(annotatedClass.getKey(), new ProcessingState.NewRoundRequired(e.getSource(), e.getType(), e.getTag(), e.getResolving()));// todo
129:                 }
130:             } catch (ProcessingErrorException e) {
131:                 log.info("Processing exception", e);
132:                 results.put(annotatedClass.getKey(), new ProcessingState.Failed(e, processingResult.stack()));
133:             } catch (Exception e) {
134:                 if (e instanceof FilerException || e.getCause() instanceof FilerException) {
135:                     this.processingEnv.getMessager().printMessage(Diagnostic.Kind.WARNING, e.getMessage());
136:                 } else {
137:                     throw new RuntimeException(e);
138:                 }
139:             }
140:         }
141:         this.annotatedElements.putAll(results);
142:         if (roundEnv.processingOver()) {
143:             for (var element : this.annotatedElements.entrySet()) {
144:                 var processingResult = element.getValue();
145:                 if (processingResult instanceof ProcessingState.NewRoundRequired newRound) {
146:                     this.processingEnv.getMessager().printMessage(Diagnostic.Kind.ERROR,
147:                         "Component was expected to be generated by extension %s but was not: %s/%s".formatted(newRound.source(), newRound.type(), newRound.tag())
148:                     );
149:                 }
150:                 if (processingResult instanceof ProcessingState.Failed failed) {
151:                     failed.detailedException().printError(this.processingEnv);
152:                     if (!failed.stack().isEmpty()) {
153:                         var i = processingResult.stack().descendingIterator();
154:                         var frames = new ArrayList<ProcessingState.ResolutionFrame.Component>();
155:                         while (i.hasNext()) {
156:                             var frame = i.next();
157:                             if (frame instanceof ProcessingState.ResolutionFrame.Component c) {
158:                                 frames.add(0, c);
159:                             } else {
160:                                 break;
161:                             }
162:                         }
163:                         var chain = frames.stream()
164:                             .map(c -> c.declaration().declarationString() + "   " + c.dependenciesToFind().get(c.currentDependency()))
165:                             .collect(Collectors.joining("\n            ^            \n            |            \n"));
166:                         this.processingEnv.getMessager().printMessage(Diagnostic.Kind.ERROR, "Dependency resolve process: \n" + chain);
167:                     }
168:                 }
169:                 if (processingResult instanceof ProcessingState.Ok ok) {
170:                     try {
171:                         this.write(element.getKey(), ok);
172:                     } catch (NewRoundException e) {
173:                         this.processingEnv.getMessager().printMessage(Diagnostic.Kind.ERROR,
174:                             "Component was expected to be generated by extension %s but was not: %s/%s".formatted(e.getSource(), e.getType(), e.getTag())
175:                         );
176:                     } catch (ProcessingErrorException e) {
177:                         e.printError(this.processingEnv);
178:                     } catch (IOException e) {
179:                         throw new RuntimeException(e);
180:                     }
181:                 }
182:             }
183:             try {
184:                 this.generateAppParts();
185:             } catch (IOException e) {
186:                 throw new RuntimeException(e);
187:             }
188:         }
189:         return false;
190:     }

212:     private boolean processComponents(RoundEnvironment roundEnv) {
213:         var componentOfElements = roundEnv.getElementsAnnotatedWith(this.componentElement);
214:         var aopWaitingComponents = new ArrayList<TypeElement>();
215:         var newComponents = new ArrayList<TypeElement>();
216:         for (var componentElement : componentOfElements) {
217:             if (componentElement.getKind() != ElementKind.CLASS) {
218:                 continue;
219:             }
220:             if (componentElement.getModifiers().contains(Modifier.ABSTRACT)) {
221:                 continue;
222:             }
223:             var typeElement = (TypeElement) componentElement;
224:             if (CommonUtils.hasAopAnnotations(typeElement)) {
225:                 aopWaitingComponents.add(typeElement);
226:             } else {
227:                 this.components.add(typeElement);
228:                 newComponents.add(typeElement);
229:             }
230:         }
231:         var newlyLoggedAopWaitingComponents = aopWaitingComponents.stream().filter(loggedComponents::add).toList();
232:         if (log.isInfoEnabled() && !newlyLoggedAopWaitingComponents.isEmpty()) {
233:             log.info("Components waiting for AOP proxy found:\n{}", newlyLoggedAopWaitingComponents.stream().map(Object::toString).sorted().collect(Collectors.joining("\n")).indent(4));
234:         }
235:         var newlyLoggedComponents = newComponents.stream().filter(loggedComponents::add).toList();
236:         if (log.isInfoEnabled() && !newlyLoggedComponents.isEmpty()) {
237:             log.info("Components found:\n{}", newlyLoggedComponents.stream().map(Object::toString).sorted().collect(Collectors.joining("\n")).indent(4));
238:         }
239:         return !componentOfElements.isEmpty();
240:     }

242:     private boolean processModules(RoundEnvironment roundEnv) {
243:         var moduleOfElements = roundEnv.getElementsAnnotatedWith(this.moduleElement);
244:         var newModules = new ArrayList<TypeElement>();
245:         for (var moduleElement : moduleOfElements) {
246:             if (moduleElement.getKind() != ElementKind.INTERFACE) {
247:                 continue;
248:             }
249:             var typeElement = (TypeElement) moduleElement;
250:             this.modules.add(typeElement);
251:             newModules.add(typeElement);
252:         }
253:         var newlyLoggedModules = newModules.stream().filter(loggedApplicationModules::add).toList();
254:         if (log.isInfoEnabled() && !newlyLoggedModules.isEmpty()) {
255:             log.info("Application modules found:\n{}", newlyLoggedModules.stream().map(Object::toString).sorted().collect(Collectors.joining("\n")).indent(4));
256:         }
257:         if (log.isInfoEnabled()) {
258:             var newlyLoggedExternalModules = this.collectExternalModules().stream().filter(loggedExternalModules::add).toList();
259:             if (!newlyLoggedExternalModules.isEmpty()) {
260:                 log.info("External modules found:\n{}", newlyLoggedExternalModules.stream().map(Object::toString).sorted().collect(Collectors.joining("\n")).indent(4));
261:             }
262:         }
263:         return !moduleOfElements.isEmpty();
264:     }

266:     private Set<TypeElement> collectExternalModules() {
267:         var externalModules = new HashSet<TypeElement>();
268:         for (var module : this.modules) {
269:             Set<TypeElement> interfaces;
270:             try {
271:                 interfaces = KoraAppUtils.collectInterfaces(this.types, module);
272:             } catch (ProcessingErrorException e) {
273:                 continue;
274:             }
275:             for (var anInterface : interfaces) {
276:                 if (anInterface == module || this.modules.contains(anInterface)) {
277:                     continue;
278:                 }
279:                 if (!AnnotationUtils.isAnnotationPresent(anInterface, CommonClassNames.module)) {
280:                     continue;
281:                 }
282:                 externalModules.add(anInterface);
283:             }
284:         }
285:         return externalModules;
286:     }

288:     private ProcessingState.Processing processNone(ProcessingState.None none) {
289:         var stack = new ArrayDeque<ProcessingState.ResolutionFrame>();
290:         for (int i = 0; i < none.rootSet().size(); i++) {
291:             stack.addFirst(new ProcessingState.ResolutionFrame.Root(i));

293:         return new ProcessingState.Processing(none.root(), none.allModules(), none.sourceDeclarations(), none.templates(), none.rootSet(), new ArrayList<>(256), stack);

296:     private ProcessingState parseNone(Element classElement) {
297:         if (classElement.getKind() != ElementKind.INTERFACE) {
298:             return new ProcessingState.Failed(new ProcessingErrorException("@KoraApp is only applicable to interfaces", classElement), new ArrayDeque<>());
299:         }
300:         try {
301:             var type = (TypeElement) classElement;
302:             var interfaces = KoraAppUtils.collectInterfaces(this.types, type);
303:             if (log.isInfoEnabled()) {
304:                 log.info("Effective modules of {}:\n{}", classElement, Stream.concat(Stream.of(type), this.modules.stream()).flatMap(t -> KoraAppUtils.collectInterfaces(this.types, t).stream())
305:                     .map(Object::toString).sorted()
306:                     .collect(Collectors.joining("\n")).indent(4));
307:             }
308:             var mixedInModuleComponents = KoraAppUtils.parseComponents(this.ctx, interfaces.stream().map(ModuleDeclaration.MixedInModule::new).toList());
309:             if (log.isDebugEnabled()) {
310:                 log.info("Effective methods of {}:\n{}", classElement, mixedInModuleComponents.stream().map(Object::toString).sorted().collect(Collectors.joining("\n")).indent(4));
311:             }
312:             var submodules = KoraAppUtils.findKoraSubmoduleModules(this.elements, interfaces);
313:             var discoveredModules = this.modules.stream().flatMap(t -> KoraAppUtils.collectInterfaces(this.types, t).stream());
314:             var allModules = Stream.concat(discoveredModules, submodules.stream()).sorted(Comparator.comparing(Objects::toString)).toList();
315:             var annotatedModulesComponents = KoraAppUtils.parseComponents(this.ctx, allModules.stream().map(ModuleDeclaration.AnnotatedModule::new).toList());
316:             var allComponents = new ArrayList<ComponentDeclaration>(this.components.size() + mixedInModuleComponents.size() + annotatedModulesComponents.size());
317:             for (var component : this.components) {
318:                 allComponents.add(ComponentDeclaration.fromAnnotated(ctx, component));
319:             }
320:             allComponents.addAll(mixedInModuleComponents);
321:             allComponents.addAll(annotatedModulesComponents);
322:             allComponents.sort(Comparator.comparing(Objects::toString));
323: 
324:             record Components(List<ComponentDeclaration> templates, List<ComponentDeclaration> nonTemplates) {}
325:             var components = allComponents.stream().collect(Collectors.teeing(
326:                 Collectors.filtering(ComponentDeclaration::isTemplate, Collectors.toList()),
327:                 Collectors.filtering(Predicate.not(ComponentDeclaration::isTemplate), Collectors.toCollection(ArrayList::new)),
328:                 Components::new
329:             ));
330: 
331:             var sourceDescriptors = components.nonTemplates;
332:             var rootSet = sourceDescriptors.stream()
333:                 .filter(cd -> AnnotationUtils.isAnnotationPresent(cd.source(), CommonClassNames.root)
334:                     || cd instanceof ComponentDeclaration.AnnotatedComponent ac && AnnotationUtils.isAnnotationPresent(ac.typeElement(), CommonClassNames.root))
335:                 .toList();
336:             return new ProcessingState.None(type, allModules, sourceDescriptors, components.templates, rootSet);
337:         } catch (ProcessingErrorException e) {
338:             return new ProcessingState.Failed(e, new ArrayDeque<>());
339:         }
340:     }

345:             .filter(e -> e.getKind() == ElementKind.CONSTRUCTOR)
346:             .filter(e -> e.getModifiers().contains(Modifier.PUBLIC))
347:             .map(ExecutableElement.class::cast)
348:             .toList();

354:         if (constructors.size() > 1) {
355:             throw new ProcessingErrorException(
356:                 "Type annotated with @Component has more then one public constructor", element
357:             );
358:         }
359:         return constructors.get(0);
360:     }

374:     private JavaFile generateApplicationGraph(Element classElement, List<TypeElement> allModules, ComponentInterceptors interceptors, List<ResolvedComponent> components) {
375:         var packageElement = (PackageElement) classElement.getEnclosingElement();
376:         var implClass = ClassName.get(packageElement.getQualifiedName().toString(), classElement.getSimpleName().toString() + "Impl");
377:         var graphName = classElement.getSimpleName().toString() + "Graph";
378:         var graphTypeName = ClassName.get(packageElement.getQualifiedName().toString(), graphName);
379: 
380:         var classBuilder = TypeSpec.classBuilder(graphName)
381:             .addAnnotation(AnnotationSpec.builder(CommonClassNames.koraGenerated).addMember("value", CodeBlock.of("$S", KoraAppProcessor.class.getCanonicalName())).build())
382:             .addOriginatingElement(classElement)
383:             .addModifiers(Modifier.PUBLIC)
384:             .addSuperinterface(ParameterizedTypeName.get(ClassName.get(Supplier.class), CommonClassNames.applicationGraphDraw))
385:             .addField(CommonClassNames.applicationGraphDraw, "graphDraw", Modifier.PRIVATE, Modifier.STATIC, Modifier.FINAL)
386:             .addMethod(MethodSpec
387:                 .methodBuilder("get")
388:                 .addAnnotation(Override.class)
389:                 .addModifiers(Modifier.PUBLIC)
390:                 .returns(CommonClassNames.applicationGraphDraw)
391:                 .addStatement("return graphDraw")
392:                 .build());
393:         for (var component : this.components) {
394:             classBuilder.addOriginatingElement(component);
395:         }
396:         for (var module : this.modules) {
397:             classBuilder.addOriginatingElement(module);
398:         }
399: 
400:         var currentClass = (TypeSpec.Builder) null;
401:         var currentConstructor = (MethodSpec.Builder) null;
402:         int holders = 0;
403:         for (int i = 0; i < components.size(); i++) {
404:             var componentNumber = i % COMPONENTS_PER_HOLDER_CLASS;
405:             if (componentNumber == 0) {
406:                 if (currentClass != null) {
407:                     currentClass.addMethod(currentConstructor.build());
408:                     classBuilder.addType(currentClass.build());
409:                     var prevNumber = ((i / COMPONENTS_PER_HOLDER_CLASS) - 1);
410:                     classBuilder.addField(graphTypeName.nestedClass("ComponentHolder" + prevNumber), "holder" + prevNumber, Modifier.PRIVATE, Modifier.STATIC, Modifier.FINAL);
411:                 }
412:                 holders++;
413:                 var className = graphTypeName.nestedClass("ComponentHolder" + i / COMPONENTS_PER_HOLDER_CLASS);
414:                 currentClass = TypeSpec.classBuilder(className)
415:                     .addModifiers(Modifier.PUBLIC, Modifier.STATIC, Modifier.FINAL);
416:                 currentConstructor = MethodSpec.constructorBuilder()
417:                     .addModifiers(Modifier.PUBLIC)
418:                     .addParameter(CommonClassNames.applicationGraphDraw, "graphDraw")
419:                     .addParameter(implClass, "impl")
420:                     .addStatement("var map = new $T<$T, $T>()", HashMap.class, String.class, Type.class)
421:                     .beginControlFlow("for (var field : $T.class.getDeclaredFields())", className)
422:                     .addStatement("if (!field.getName().startsWith($S)) continue", "component")
423:                     .addStatement("map.put(field.getName(), (($T) field.getGenericType()).getActualTypeArguments()[0])", ParameterizedType.class)
424:                     .endControlFlow();
425:                 for (int j = 0; j < i / COMPONENTS_PER_HOLDER_CLASS; j++) {
426:                     currentConstructor.addParameter(graphTypeName.nestedClass("ComponentHolder" + j), "ComponentHolder" + j);
427:                 }
428:             }
429:             var component = components.get(i);
430:             currentClass.addField(FieldSpec.builder(ParameterizedTypeName.get(CommonClassNames.node, TypeName.get(component.type()).box()), component.fieldName(), Modifier.PRIVATE, Modifier.FINAL).build());
431:             currentConstructor.addStatement("var _type_of_$L = map.get($S)", component.fieldName(), component.fieldName());
432:             var statement = this.generateComponentStatement(graphTypeName, allModules, interceptors, components, component);
433:             currentConstructor.addStatement(statement);
434:         }
435:         if (components.size() > 0) {
436:             var lastComponentNumber = components.size() / COMPONENTS_PER_HOLDER_CLASS;
437:             if (components.size() % COMPONENTS_PER_HOLDER_CLASS == 0) {
438:                 lastComponentNumber--;
439:             }
440:             currentClass.addMethod(currentConstructor.build());
441:             classBuilder.addType(currentClass.build());
442:             classBuilder.addField(graphTypeName.nestedClass("ComponentHolder" + lastComponentNumber), "holder" + lastComponentNumber, Modifier.PRIVATE, Modifier.STATIC, Modifier.FINAL);
443:         }
444: 
445: 
446:         var staticBlock = CodeBlock.builder();
447: 
448:         staticBlock
449:             .addStatement("var impl = new $T()", implClass)
450:             .addStatement("graphDraw = new $T($T.class)", CommonClassNames.applicationGraphDraw, classElement);
451:         for (int i = 0; i < holders; i++) {
452:             staticBlock.add("$N = new $T(graphDraw, impl", "holder" + i, graphTypeName.nestedClass("ComponentHolder" + i));
453:             for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
454:                 staticBlock.add(", holder" + j);
455:             }
456:             staticBlock.add(");\n");
457:         }
458: 
459:         var supplierMethodBuilder = MethodSpec.methodBuilder("graph")
460:             .returns(CommonClassNames.applicationGraphDraw)
461:             .addModifiers(Modifier.PUBLIC, Modifier.STATIC)
462:             .addStatement("return graphDraw", graphName);
463: 
464: 
465:         return JavaFile.builder(packageElement.getQualifiedName().toString(), classBuilder
466:                 .addMethod(supplierMethodBuilder.build())
467:                 .addStaticBlock(staticBlock.build())
468:                 .build())
469:             .build();
470:     }

472:     private CodeBlock generateComponentStatement(ClassName graphTypeName, List<TypeElement> allModules, ComponentInterceptors interceptors, List<ResolvedComponent> components, ResolvedComponent component) {
473:         var statement = CodeBlock.builder();
474:         var declaration = component.declaration();
475:         statement.add("$L = graphDraw.addNode0(_type_of_$L, ", component.fieldName(), component.fieldName());
476:         statement.add("new Class<?>[]{");
477:         for (var tag : component.tags()) {
478:             statement.add("$L.class, ", tag);
479:         }
480:         statement.add("}, g -> ");
481:         var dependenciesCode = this.generateDependenciesCode(component, graphTypeName, components);
482: 
483:         if (declaration instanceof ComponentDeclaration.AnnotatedComponent annotatedComponent) {
484:             statement.add("new $T", annotatedComponent.typeElement());
485:             if (!annotatedComponent.typeVariables().isEmpty()) {
486:                 statement.add("<");
487:                 for (int i = 0; i < annotatedComponent.typeVariables().size(); i++) {
488:                     if (i > 0) statement.add(", ");
489:                     statement.add("$T", annotatedComponent.typeVariables().get(i));
490:                 }
491:                 statement.add(">");
492:             }
493:             statement.add("($L)", dependenciesCode);
494:         } else if (declaration instanceof ComponentDeclaration.FromModuleComponent moduleComponent) {
495:             if (moduleComponent.module() instanceof ModuleDeclaration.AnnotatedModule annotatedModule) {
496:                 statement.add("impl.module$L.", allModules.indexOf(annotatedModule.element()));
497:             } else {
498:                 statement.add("impl.");
499:             }
500:             if (!moduleComponent.typeVariables().isEmpty()) {
501:                 statement.add("<");
502:                 for (int i = 0; i < moduleComponent.typeVariables().size(); i++) {
503:                     if (i > 0) statement.add(", ");
504:                     statement.add("$T", moduleComponent.typeVariables().get(i));
505:                 }
506:                 statement.add(">");
507:             }
508:             statement.add("$L($L)", moduleComponent.method().getSimpleName(), dependenciesCode);
509:         } else if (declaration instanceof ComponentDeclaration.FromExtensionComponent extension) {
510:             statement.add(extension.generator().apply(dependenciesCode));
511:         } else if (declaration instanceof ComponentDeclaration.DiscoveredAsDependencyComponent asDependencyComponent) {
512:             if (asDependencyComponent.typeElement().getTypeParameters().isEmpty()) {
513:                 statement.add("new $T($L)", ClassName.get(asDependencyComponent.typeElement()), dependenciesCode);
514:             } else {
515:                 statement.add("new $T<>($L)", ClassName.get(asDependencyComponent.typeElement()), dependenciesCode);
516:             }
517:         } else if (declaration instanceof ComponentDeclaration.PromisedProxyComponent promisedProxyComponent) {
518:             if (promisedProxyComponent.typeElement().getTypeParameters().isEmpty()) {
519:                 statement.add("new $T($L)", promisedProxyComponent.className(), dependenciesCode);
520:             } else {
521:                 statement.add("new $T<>($L)", promisedProxyComponent.className(), dependenciesCode);
522:             }
523:         } else if (declaration instanceof ComponentDeclaration.OptionalComponent optional) {
524:             var optionalOf = ((DeclaredType) optional.type()).getTypeArguments().get(0);
525:             statement.add("$T.<$T>ofNullable($L)", Optional.class, optionalOf, dependenciesCode);
526:         } else {
527:             throw new RuntimeException("Unknown type " + declaration);
528:         }
529:         var resolvedDependencies = component.dependencies();
530:         statement.add(", $T.of(", List.class);
531:         var interceptorsFor = interceptors.interceptorsFor(component);
532:         for (int i = 0; i < interceptorsFor.size(); i++) {
533:             var interceptor = interceptorsFor.get(i);
534:             if (component.holderName().equals(interceptor.component().holderName())) {
535:                 statement.add("$N", interceptor.component().fieldName());
536:             } else {
537:                 statement.add("$N.$N", interceptor.component().holderName(), interceptor.component().fieldName());
538:             }
539:             if (i < interceptorsFor.size() - 1) {
540:                 statement.add(", ");
541:             }
542:         }
543:         statement.add(")");
544:         for (var resolvedDependency : resolvedDependencies) {
545:             if (resolvedDependency instanceof ComponentDependency.AllOfDependency allOf) {
546:                 if (allOf.claim().claimType() != DependencyClaim.DependencyClaimType.ALL_OF_PROMISE) {
547:                     var dependencies = GraphResolutionHelper.findDependenciesForAllOf(ctx, allOf.claim(), components);
548:                     for (var dependency : dependencies) {
549:                         if (component.holderName().equals(dependency.component().holderName())) {
550:                             statement.add(", $N", dependency.component().fieldName());
551:                         } else {
552:                             statement.add(", $N.$N", dependency.component().holderName(), dependency.component().fieldName());
553:                         }
554:                         if (allOf.claim().claimType() == DependencyClaim.DependencyClaimType.ALL_OF_VALUE) {
555:                             statement.add(".valueOf()");
556:                         }
557:                     }
558:                 }
559:                 continue;
560:             }
561:             if (resolvedDependency instanceof ComponentDependency.PromiseOfDependency || resolvedDependency instanceof ComponentDependency.PromisedProxyParameterDependency) {
562:                 continue;
563:             }
564: 
565:             if (resolvedDependency instanceof ComponentDependency.SingleDependency dependency && dependency.component() != null) {
566:                 if (component.holderName().equals(dependency.component().holderName())) {
567:                     statement.add(", $N", dependency.component().fieldName());
568:                 } else {
569:                     statement.add(", $N.$N", dependency.component().holderName(), dependency.component().fieldName());
570:                 }
571:                 if (resolvedDependency instanceof ComponentDependency.ValueOfDependency) {
572:                     statement.add(".valueOf()");
573:                 }
574:             }
575:         }

580:     private CodeBlock generateDependenciesCode(ResolvedComponent component, ClassName graphTypeName, List<ResolvedComponent> components) {
581:         var resolvedDependencies = component.dependencies();
582:         if (resolvedDependencies.isEmpty()) {
583:             return CodeBlock.of("");
584:         }
585:         var b = CodeBlock.builder();
586:         b.indent();
587:         b.add("\n");
588:         for (int i = 0, dependenciesSize = resolvedDependencies.size(); i < dependenciesSize; i++) {
589:             if (i > 0) b.add(",\n");
590:             var resolvedDependency = resolvedDependencies.get(i);
591:             b.add(resolvedDependency.write(this.ctx, graphTypeName, components));
592:         }
593:         b.unindent();
594:         b.add("\n");
595:         return b.build();

598:     private JavaFile generateImpl(TypeElement classElement, List<TypeElement> modules) throws IOException {

603:             .addAnnotation(AnnotationSpec.builder(CommonClassNames.koraGenerated).addMember("value", CodeBlock.of("$S", KoraAppProcessor.class.getCanonicalName())).build())
604:             .addOriginatingElement(classElement)
605:             .addModifiers(Modifier.PUBLIC, Modifier.FINAL)
606:             .addSuperinterface(typeMirror);

611:                 .initializer("new $T(){}", module.asType())

613:             classBuilder.addOriginatingElement(module);
614:         }

616:             classBuilder.addOriginatingElement(component);
617:         }
618: 
619: 
620:         return JavaFile.builder(packageElement.getQualifiedName().toString(), classBuilder.build())
621:             .build();
622:     }

646:                     .addModifiers(Modifier.PUBLIC, Modifier.DEFAULT);

650:                     for (var tp : component.getTypeParameters()) {
651:                         mb.addTypeVariable(TypeVariableName.get(tp));
652:                     }

36:     fun build(repositoryDeclaration: KSClassDeclaration): TypeSpec? {

38:         val name = repositoryDeclaration.getOuterClassesAsPrefix() + repositoryDeclaration.simpleName.asString() + "_Impl"
39:         val builder = repositoryDeclaration.extendsKeepAop(name)
40:             .generated(RepositoryBuilder::class)
41:             .addOriginatingKSFile(repositoryDeclaration.containingFile!!)
42:         val constructorBuilder = FunSpec.constructorBuilder()
43:         if (repositoryDeclaration.classKind == ClassKind.CLASS) {

46:         val repositoryType = repositoryDeclaration.asType(listOf())
47:         for (availableGenerator in this.availableGenerators) {

The declarative logging annotation processor generates verbose and hard-to-read code when applying `@Log`, `@LogIn`, and `@LogOut` annotations to methods. The current implementation uses manual string concatenation and indentation markers (`$>`, `$<`, `\n`) which produce inconsistent formatting, especially with nested conditional blocks and lambda expressions. This reduces the debuggability of generated code and makes it harder for developers to inspect what the annotation processor produces.

    We need to refactor the code generation logic in `LogAspect` to use JavaPoet's `CodeBlock` builder methods (`beginControlFlow`, `endControlFlow`, `nextControlFlow`, `addStatement`) consistently. This will produce cleaner, properly indented generated code that is easier to read and maintain.
